title: ‘Dune Cottage’ sells for $72M after $120M asking price
summary_full: Dune Cottage in East Hampton has changed hands for an impressive $72 million, demonstrating a notable shift in the high-end real estate landscape. Initially hitting the market at $120 million, the asking price was reduced after a prolonged listing. This historic estate, once owned by Lee Radziwill, holds significant architectural value and has undergone extensive renovations following a damaging fire.
